title: Local gas of the order cycle on the final contracts (2026-10-12)

off.name: baseline (b): privacy contracts, every mechanism off

noEncryption.name: without the encryption of the order's content (and so without the late release)

noPoolFunding.name: without the funding from the pool (payment commitment kept)

noPoolNote.name: without the payment commitment (funding from the pool kept)

onlyOneTime.name: only the one-time address and its stipend

onlyEncryption.name: only the encryption of the order's content, with the late release

onlyPool.name: only the pool (funding and payment commitment)

rule.text: gas(i) = base + 2079 * (ones(i) - 1) + 17100 if i = 2^k - 1 (first write of level k); the last leaf 2^25 - 1 costs 5049 less
rule.exactAt84IndicesWithTheSameCalldata: carried over from the afternoon (depositPayment and the harness; Reputation.sol is unchanged)

baseCycle.note: computed: the eight other calls plus the three bases

computedFromTheRule.convention: base cycle + 3 x the mean extra of a leaf over all leaves below n (2 x without the pool deposit); largest = base cycle + the largest extra of any three consecutive leaves below n. Extras per leaf carried over from the afternoon: the rule did not change.

carriedOver.why: GlobalReputation (mergeWithdraw) did not change; this evening no cash-out landed on leaf 2^24 - 1
